mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and a temperature of 79 degrees at Verona Community Park.

The City of Verona recently approved updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure self-supporting systems, and we also announced the four student winners of the I Voted sticker contest for the November election.

Today you can catch the Epic Systems UGM or yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow brings trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by Wednesday's downtown farmer's market and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Our police report highlights that on Friday, August 15, a 29-year-old Verona man was arrested for a second offence O W I after being reported for reckless driving.
Today's flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, available until the store closes at 10 PM tonight.
